Welcome to this evening's sleep meditation.
Find a comfortable position, either sitting up or lying down in bed, and gently close your eyes.
Take a deep breath in through your nose, filling your lungs completely,
and then slowly exhale through your mouth. Let go of any tension you may be holding on to,
allowing your body to sink deeper into relaxation with each breath.
Imagine yourself lying down in a cozy cabin. Outside, the rain is softly tapping against
the windows. The rhythm lulls you into a state of deep relaxation.
As you continue to breathe deeply, listen to the gentle pattern of raindrops,
each one carrying a sense of calm and tranquility. Feel the warmth of the
cabin surrounding you like a protective cocoon, shielding you from the outside world.
With each inhale, imagine yourself drawing in the pure, refreshing energy of the rain,
filling your body with a sense of renewal and rejuvenation. And with each exhale, release any
remaining tension or negative thoughts, allowing them to be washed away by the gentle rain.
Focus on the sound of the rain outside, letting it wash over you like a soothing melody,
guiding you into a state of deep relaxation. Feel the tension melting away from your muscles,
leaving you light and peaceful. Continue to breathe deeply and rhythmically, sinking deeper
into relaxation with each breath. Allow yourself to be fully present in this moment,
letting go of any worry about the past or future. Know that you are safe and protected in
this cozy cabin, surrounded by the soothing sounds of nature. Allow yourself to drift off
into a deep and restful sleep, knowing that you are exactly where you need to be.
Now, as you continue to rest peacefully, let these affirmations sink into your subconscious.
